configClearConfirmMessage: Syncing with this backend stops. Diaries on this device are untouched.
notConfiguredTap: Not configured — tap to set up
stopSubtitle: Syncing in the background — tap to stop
willStop: Will stop once the current item finishes
lanSendSubtitle: Send entries to a device on the same Wi-Fi
lanReceiveSubtitle: Wait for another device to send to this one
autoSyncSubtitle: Push after an entry changes, and pull other devices' changes on a timer
pollIntervalSubtitle: How often to pull other devices' changes in the background
pollIntervalNote: How often a full two-way sync runs in the background. A shorter interval picks up other devices' changes sooner, but every poll takes the remote lock, reads the manifest and makes network requests — too short and you pay for it in traffic and battery, and may hit WebDAV / S3 rate limits or a temporary ban. 30 seconds is a sensible floor.
concurrencySubtitle: Upper bound on parallel network requests while syncing; lower it on a weak connection or against a rate-limited server
concurrencyNote: 8 by default. Higher is faster, but may trip WebDAV / S3 rate limits or get connections refused.
logClearMessage: This deletes the in-memory event stream and every daily jsonl file. It cannot be undone.
logEmpty: No sync events on this date
statusNoBackendDetail: Set one up under Backup and sync
lanSendIntro: Only what the other device is missing gets sent. Changes merge by last-modified time, so sending twice never duplicates anything.
lanAddressHint: Filled in when you pick a device above
lanPinHint: The 6 digits shown on the receiving device
lanPickDevice: Pick a device to send to first
lanSearching: Searching — open the Receive page on the other device
lanApplying: Waiting for the other device to save…
lanPinHelp: Enter it on the sending device · tap to copy
lanUpToDate: Already up to date — nothing changed
lanWaiting: Waiting for the sender to connect…
lanDonePartialHint: Some content did not arrive. Check storage space and receive again; don't delete the sender's data until you've confirmed it's complete
lanDoneHint: You can keep receiving — the pairing code stays the same
lanFailedHint: The pairing code is unchanged, so the sender can just retry
lanNoWifi: Not on Wi-Fi — this device has no address to show
keyGuardMissing: The remote data is encrypted but its key file (keys.json) is missing, so it cannot be decrypted. Clear the remote data and upload again.
keyGuardMessageMismatch: This device's key cannot decrypt the remote data. Enter the same encryption password as the original device; syncing starts once it checks out.
keyGuardMessage: The remote data is encrypted. Enter the same encryption password as the original device; syncing starts once it checks out.
keyGuardWrong: Wrong password — the remote data cannot be decrypted
keyMismatch: The two passwords do not match
keyChanged: Password changed — the data key is unchanged, so nothing needs re-encrypting
keyEncryptCloudTitle: Encrypt the data already in the cloud
keyEncryptCloudMessage: This backend already holds data. Confirming generates a random data key and encrypts the remote entries, categories and media files. The key itself is wrapped with your password and stored remotely.
keyWriteFailed: Could not write the key file to the cloud, cancelled: {error}
keyDecryptMessage: Turning encryption off decrypts the remote entries, categories and media files back to plain text and deletes the key file. Continue?
keyDecryptPartial: {failed} object(s) could not be decrypted, so encryption stays on and the remote key file was kept. Check your connection and try turning it off again.
keyEncryptPartial: {failed} objects could not be encrypted and are still plaintext in the cloud. To finish them, turn encryption off and back on — re-entering a password only changes it.
keyRemoteEmpty: The remote is empty — only the local key was saved
keyUnlocked: Unlocked the remote key with that password
keyChangedLocalOnly: Password updated on this device. The remote is encrypted with a different key — unlock it and the new password syncs automatically.
keyRemoteProbeFailed: Could not read the remote key file, so nothing was changed: {error}
keyRemoteMismatchTitle: That password does not open the remote key
keyRemoteMismatchMessage: The remote data was encrypted with a different password. Go back and try the original one. You can also discard the encrypted remote data and re-upload this device's data with a new password.
keyDiscardMessage: The diaries, categories and media currently on the remote can never be decrypted again, and this cannot be undone. Data on this device is untouched and will be re-uploaded with the new password on the next sync. Continue?
keyDiscardFailed: Could not remove the remote key file, so nothing was changed: {error}
keyConflictSubtitle: The remote is encrypted with a different key and sync is paused. Tap to enter the password.
errKeyConflict: The remote is encrypted with a different key that this device cannot open. Sync stopped so the remote key file is not overwritten.
lanReceiveHint: The sender usually finds this device on its own; the address above can also be typed in by hand. Keep this page open while receiving.
errKeyfileCorrupt: The remote key file is corrupt (not a JSON object)
errKeyfileKdfMissing: The remote key file is corrupt (KDF parameters missing)
errKeyfileKdfRange: The remote key file's KDF parameters are out of the allowed range
errKeyfileParse: Could not parse the remote key file: {error}
errKeyfileFields: The remote key file is corrupt (fields missing)
errKeyfileVersion: The remote key file is too new (v{version}; this build supports up to v{supported}). Update the app.
errManifestVersion: Backup format version mismatch: the data is v{remote}, this device supports v{local}. Open it with a matching version rather than letting this one overwrite it
errManifestEntriesCorrupt: The backup manifest's entries field is corrupt (not an object); stopped to avoid losing entries
errDecryptFailed: Could not decrypt the file — the key may not match
errManifestCorrupt: The remote manifest is corrupt (not a JSON object). Sync was stopped so remote entries are not lost.
errManifestReCipher: The remote manifest is malformed and cannot be re-encrypted
errManifestRace: Another device overwrote the manifest while it was being written; re-encryption was stopped
errLegacyBackup: This backup was created by a version older than 2.8.0 and cannot be imported. Restore it in the old version first, then upgrade.
errBackupParse: Could not parse the backup file: {error}
errNotReceiver: That host is not a Moodiary receiver
errVersionMismatch: Version mismatch — update Moodiary on both devices to the same version
errReceiverOffline: The other device is not receiving. Make sure its Receive page is open.
errWrongKeyPassword: Wrong password — the key file could not be unlocked
errLocked: Another device is syncing right now — try again shortly
errMediaUpload: Some media files failed to upload, so this entry was skipped
errNoUserKey: The remote files are encrypted but no user key is configured
errReadRemote: Could not read the remote object ({key}): {error}
errCreateRemote: Could not create the remote object ({key}): {error}
warnRemoteEmpty: The remote is empty — nothing has been uploaded yet
warnMediaFailed: {count} media file(s) could not be downloaded; images or audio may be missing from those entries
warnStopped: Stopped by you — the rest will continue on the next sync
lanAuthLocked: Too many incorrect pairing codes. This session is locked — start receiving again to get a new code.
